meta.direction: Warm Glass (D16, Kris, 2026-10-17): the premium evolution of Neo-Tactile. The reference image's colors stay (warm off-white page, cream, sand, taupe, sage, dusty rose; blue only for focus). Cards are paper with a long soft lift; floating bars, sheets and chips over photos are glass; wells stay sunken only where something is tactile; one deep-sage action per screen (white on it 5.2:1); Frank Ruhl Libre for moments, IBM Plex Sans Hebrew for everything else. Eight principles: docs/25_Design_System.md section 2.

accents.usage: WL2 (docs/35 section 3): the eight accents a studio may choose, by id. Each sets the brand tokens only, in both themes, through data-accent on <html>; surfaces, ink, status and category colours stay Tempo's. sage is today's look and equals the root brand tokens. check-tokens.mjs holds every accent to the contrast floors.
